subject: general
question:
Simplify the following expression:

{{{(a²-4b²)}³} + 64 {{(b² - 4c²)}³} + {{(16c² -a²})³}} over {{(a-2b)³} +{(2b-4c)³} +{(4c-a)³}}
solution:
**Given:**

The given expression = {{{(a²-4b²)}³} + 64 {{(b² - 4c²)}³} + {{(16c² -a²})³}} over {{(a-2b)³} +{(2b-4c)³} +{(4c-a)³}}

**Formula used:**

If a + b + c = 0 then a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc

**Calculation:**

{{{(a²-4b²)}³} + 64 {{(b² - 4c²)}³} + {{(16c² -a²})³}} over {{(a-2b)³} +{(2b-4c)³} +{(4c-a)³}}

= {{{(a²-4b²)}³} + {{(4b² - 16c²)}³} + {{(16c² -a²})³}} over {{(a-2b)³} +{(2b-4c)³} +{(4c-a)³}}

Let, a² - 4b² = x; 4b² - 16c² = y; 16c² - a² = z

Here, x + y + z = a2 - 4b2 + 4b2 - 16c2 + 16c2 - a2 = 0

Then, (a2 - 4b2)³ + (4b2 - 16c2)³ + (16c2 - a2)³ = 3 (a2 - 4b2) (4b2 - 16c2) (16c2 - a2)

Let, a - 2b = p; 2b - 4c = q; 4c - a = r

Here, p + q + r = a - 2b + 2b - 4c + 4c - a = 0

Then, (a - 2b)³ + (2b - 4c)³ + (4c - a)³ = 3 (a - 2b) (2b - 4c) (4c - a)

Now, {{{(a²-4b²)}³} + {{(4b² - 16c²)}³} + {{(16c² -a²})³}} over {{(a-2b)³} +{(2b-4c)³} +{(4c-a)³}} = (3(a²-4b²)(4b²-16c²)(16c²-a²))/(3(a-2b)(2b-4c)(4c-a))

= ((a+2b)(a-2b)(2b+4c)(2b-4c)(4c+a)(4c-a))/((a-2b)(2b-4c)(4c-a)) [Using a² - b² = (a + b) (a - b) formula]

= (a + 2b) (2b + 4c) (4c + a)

= 2 (a + 2b) (b + 2c) (4c + a)

**∴ The value of the expression is 2 (a+ 2b) (b + 2c) (4c + a)**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** {{{(a²-4b²)}³} + 64 {{(b² - 4c²)}³} + {{(16c² -a²})³}} over {{(a-2b)³} +{(2b-4c)³} +{(4c-a)³}} 

We know that a + b + c = 0 then a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc

First, we satisfy the numerator and denominator with this equation.

⇒ (a² - 4b²) + (4b² - 16c²) + (16c² - a²) = 0 

Now, (a - 2b) + (2b - 4c) + (4c - a) = 0

{{{(a²-4b²)}³} + 64 {{(b² - 4c²)}³} + {{(16c² -a²})³}} over {{(a-2b)³} +{(2b-4c)³} +{(4c-a)³}}

⇒ {3{(a²-4b²)}{(4b² - 16c²)}{(16c² -a²})} over {3{(a-2b)}{(2b-4c)}{(4c-a)}} = {(a-2b)(a+2b)(2b-4c)(2b+4c)(4c-a)(4c+a)}over{(a-2b)(2b-4c)(4c-a)} 

⇒ (a + 2b){2(b + 2c)}(4c + a)

⇒ 2(a + 2b)(b + 2c)(4c + a)

**∴ The value of the expression is 2(a + 2b)(b + 2c)(4c + a).**
